expected.title: Uniform perimeter improvement of planar radial cluster stars with more than three rays for strictly convex anisotropic densities smooth in direction
expected.author: Valentina Franceschi; Aldo Pratelli; Giorgio Stefani
expected.difficulty_reason: Euclidean120-degree junction arguments do not establish a competitor for a nonsymmetric anisotropic perimeter, whose exterior and interior interfaces have different costs. The source constructs competitors in all white/colored configurations and uses first-order tangent estimates to rule out the nondegenerate cases, then builds a separate three-segment competitor for the degenerate four-sector case. The small-angle reduction and compactness turn these strict improvements into a uniform positive gain, leaving a complete geometric construction beyond routine convexity terminology.
